text: 金十数据8月5日讯，*ST卓然公告，因公司2025年度财务报告被天职国际出具无法表示意见的审计报告，触及《股票上市规则》第12.4.2条规定，上海证券交易所将对公司股票继续实施财务类退市风险警示；因公司2025年度财务报告内部控制被天职国际出具否定意见的审计报告，触及第12.9.1条相关规定，将对公司股票实施其他风险警示。公司股票自2026年8月6日起继续实施财务类退市风险警示并实施其他风险警示，证券简称仍为“*ST卓然”，证券代码仍为“688121”，日涨跌幅限制仍为20%。
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: *ST Zhuoran announced that because the company's 2025 annual financial report was issued with a disclaimer of opinion audit report by Tianzhi International, triggering the provisions of Article 12.4.2 of the Stock Listing Rules, the Shanghai Stock Exchange will continue to impose financial delisting risk warning on the company's shares; because the company's 2025 internal control over financial reporting was issued with an adverse opinion audit report by Tianzhi International, triggering the relevant provisions of Article 12.9.1, an other risk warning will be imposed on the company's shares. The company's shares will continue to be subject to financial delisting risk warning and other risk warning from August 6, 2026. The securities abbreviation remains "*ST Zhuoran," the securities code remains "688121," and the daily price limit remains 20%.
